steps.label: Capture the actual plan
steps.sub: a Clustered Index Scan is reading every row

steps.label: Measure before and after
steps.sub: the only proof the fix actually worked

code:
SELECT mid.statement, migs.avg_user_impact,
       mid.equality_columns, mid.inequality_columns,
       mid.included_columns
FROM sys.dm_db_missing_index_details mid
JOIN sys.dm_db_missing_index_groups mig
  ON mid.index_handle = mig.index_handle
JOIN sys.dm_db_missing_index_group_stats migs
  ON mig.index_group_handle = migs.group_handle
WHERE mid.statement LIKE '%WorkOrders%';
caption: Status, ScheduledStartDate, and MachineID -- a 93% estimated impact.

eyebrow: A real, named index -- built online
code:
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX
  IX_WorkOrders_Status_ScheduledStartDate
ON dbo.WorkOrders (Status, ScheduledStartDate)
INCLUDE (MachineID)
WITH (ONLINE = ON);
caption: 52 seconds before. About 0.4 seconds after -- an Index Seek, not a scan.
